name: @pipeworx/mcp-spp

tools.name: spp_generation_mix
tools.description: SPP (Southwest Power Pool — 14 US states from the Texas panhandle to North Dakota) real-time generation by fuel type at 5-minute resolution: coal, natural gas, nuclear, wind, solar, hydro, diesel fuel oil, energy storage, waste heat, waste disposal, other, plus total load. Returns MW per fuel per interval. AUTHORITATIVE for SPP grid mix — PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "how much wind is SPP running right now", "SPP fuel mix today", "SPP wind share of load".

limit.description: Latest N 5-minute intervals to return (default 12 = the most recent hour, max 2000).

detailed.description: true = split each fuel into its Market and Self-scheduled halves over a rolling 365-day feed. Default false (the plain current-day feed).

tools.name: spp_load_forecast
tools.description: SPP load, wind and solar forecast vs actual at 5-minute resolution: short-term and mid-term load forecast (STLF/MTLF), wind forecast (STWF/MTWF), solar forecast (STSF/MTSF) and the actual load, wind and solar delivered. Use for "is SPP load beating forecast", "SPP wind forecast error today", "when does SPP peak".

limit.description: Latest N intervals that have actuals (default 12, max 2000).

include_future.description: true = also return the forward forecast intervals that have no actuals yet. Default false.

tools.name: spp_lmp_latest
tools.description: SPP real-time balancing market (RTBM) locational marginal prices — the most recently published 5-minute interval, per settlement location, with the LMP split into its marginal energy (MEC), congestion (MCC) and loss (MLC) components. Several hundred settlement locations per interval. Use for "SPP power price right now", "which SPP locations are congested", "SPP price spike".

location.description: Filter to settlement locations whose name contains this text, case-insensitive (e.g. "AECC", "SPPNORTH_HUB").

tools.name: spp_files
tools.description: Browse the SPP Marketplace public file archive — the raw published market data behind every SPP report, back to 2013. Lists folders and files (name, path, size, modified) for a dataset, or downloads one file as parsed rows. Datasets include rtbm-lmp-by-location, da-lmp-by-location and the other Marketplace feeds. Use when you need a SPECIFIC historical interval, day or dataset rather than the current snapshot.

dataset.description: Marketplace dataset name, e.g. "rtbm-lmp-by-location" or "da-lmp-by-location". This is the fsName in SPP's own file browser.

path.description: Folder or file path inside the dataset, e.g. "/" or "/2026/09/By_Interval/17". Default "/".

download.description: true = treat `path` as a FILE and return its parsed rows instead of a directory listing. Default false.

limit.description: Max entries or rows to return (default 100, max 2000).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-spp forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the spp pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
